title: Dragon Ball Z: Infinite World arrives on PlayStation 2
summary: In 2008, Dragon Ball Z: Infinite World became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.

blocks.text: In 2008, Dragon Ball Z: Infinite World became a notable game release milestone in PlayStation 2 history.
In the action and adventure category, Dragon Ball Z: Infinite World broadened the PlayStation 2 library and reflects the range of experiences available during the console's long commercial life.
